checks.name: migration_sanity
checks.description: Deterministic check for BUILD.bazel presence and syntax check

checks.name: visibility_audit
checks.description: Audits BUILD.bazel visibility attributes for package-level default_visibility, missing target visibility, overly narrow sprawling visibility lists (>15 entries across >=6 areas on globally-used platform libraries/test utilities that should use target-level //visibility:public or 2-3 level rollups), unjustified //visibility:public on narrow targets, redundant :__pkg__, disguised public wildcards, multi-domain umbrella wildcards, cross-area depth-2 wildcards, overbroad depth>=3 LCA wildcards, and false-positive rdeps

checks.name: build_only_scope
checks.description: Fails if the migration change (HEAD commit, uncommitted, or untracked files) modifies any non-build file (anything other than BUILD.gn/BUILD.bazel/BUILD/*.gni/*.bzl/MODULE.bazel). Migrations must not edit source code.

checks.name: lint_config_parity
checks.description: Flags lint-driven source edits (removed .clone(), added #[allow]/#[expect]/NOLINT, removed use imports, let _ =) in non-build files with file:line evidence, and warns when BUILD.bazel lint_config is outside //build/config/rust/lints (Bazel replaces default lints, GN appends).
